items.excerpt: OMNi (alpha v0.1) is a free, Rust-built DAW with native AI sample generation and image-to-sound synthesis, bundling 14 synth engines and 16 FX — folding generative AI directly into the workstation rather than a bolt-on plugin.

Sonarworks expands its SoundID VoiceAI voice-changer with a C-pop Voices Expansion Pack — 10 studio-grade AI voice models trained on ethically sourced material for Mandopop/Cantopop — letting producers re-sing a take in a different voice inside the DAW.

Artist Growth launches what it calls the first MCP server for the music industry, anchoring ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini to permissioned operational data so managers and labels can safely automate real music-business workflows with agentic AI.

Developer Matt Goodluck introduces ToneField, a generative software instrument for Mac and Windows that revives the discontinued TonePad Pro concept with modern generative-sequencing features for evolving, hands-off musical patterns.
